turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_shg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `shg` (the
    largest SHG tensor component |d_ij|, in pm/V).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict each candidate's largest SHG tensor
component |d_ij|, then select the 5 candidates whose |d_ij| is CLOSEST to 20
pm/V.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, closest first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training set shows that SHG responses near 20 pm/V arise from a small number of well-defined structural families: tetragonal defect-chalcopyrite/stannite chalcogenides (CdGa_{2}S_{4}-type, AlHg_{2}S_{4}-type, Cu/Ag-Ga/Al sulfides) and a handful of chemically similar pnictides (Ca_{8}Cd_{4}P_{8}). Lattice metrics, cation ordering and anion polarizability within each family produce only modest shifts in |d_ij|.

- c051 (Zn_{2}Ga_{4}S_{8}) is isostructural with the training example Cd_{2}Ga_{4}S_{8} (21.7 pm/V) and possesses nearly identical tetragonal metrics; the Zn/Cd substitution lowers the value only slightly, placing it nearest 20.
- c087 (Ca_{8}Cd_{4}As_{8}) is the direct arsenide analogue of Ca_{8}Cd_{4}P_{8} (20.26 pm/V) with the same orthorhombic packing; the P\to As change increases polarizability modestly.
- c075 (Al_{2}Ga_{2}Cu_{4}S_{8}) belongs to the same I-III-VI_{2} sulfide family as Ga_{4}Cu_{2}Ag_{2}S_{8} (21.16 pm/V) and shares the same ~5.4 Å \times 10.6 Å cell.
- c052 is a second, slightly elongated ZnGa_{2}S_{4} polytype whose c/a ratio remains inside the range that yields ~20 pm/V for this chemistry.
- c050 (cubic ZnGa_{2}S_{4}) is the zinc-blende-ordered end-member of the same Zn–Ga–S series and therefore interpolates between ZnS (~15) and the tetragonal phases (~20).

All other candidates lie farther away: heavier anions (Se/Te) or more polarizable cations push |d_ij| well above 30, while alkali-halide or centrosymmetric packings collapse it toward zero.

Final: c051, c087, c075, c052, c050
